blurb: Industrial fishing and vessel traffic in the EBSA's waters. Less pressure scores higher.

charts.label: label

method: Fishing effort is Global Fishing Watch apparent fishing hours for 2024, all gears, per 1,000 km² of the EBSA. Vessel density is the IMF / World Bank global AIS layer, total positions from January 2015 to February 2021 per km²; it stops near ±85°, so polar cells have no value. Both are AIS-based and miss vessels that do not broadcast. The direction is reversed for scoring: the EBSA with the least pressure scores 100. Use the scoring panel to reverse it if pressure should count towards priority instead. Scores are mid-rank percentiles (0–100) among the EBSAs with data, with direction applied so higher is better for the pillar; tied values share the midpoint of their rank range. The pillar score is the plain mean of the variable percentiles. All of this is provisional.
